Ravi (Partnerships): heads-up: HW partner wants a joint "Innovation Lab" slot at the conference — 30m live demo + 15m audience Q&A. need runbook, AV, and co-branded swag plan. who can take runbook?
Nina - Events: I can draft runbook. question: live demo wants access to our staging cluster or local appliance? AV wise we need HDMI + secondary laptop for failover.
Eli (HW Partner): we'll bring a pre-provisioned appliance. would like to test network egress to Redwood staging (IP allowlist?). prefer local-only fallback if connectivity flaps.
Cara - Marketing: co-branded swag idea: 250 demo postcards + 150 mini-hoodies. customs issue for hoodies -> might delay. recommend stickers + postcards for international.
Ravi (Partnerships): agree stickers+postcards for intl. Nina please list hoodie pickup onsite only. Eli: can you confirm appliance weight and crate dims for shipping?
Eli (HW Partner): crate dims 48x30x20in, ~35kg. ETA to venue Tue morning if shipped next-day. I'll upload tracking.
Nina - Events: adding tech check slot 45min day-before. need contact onsite for appliance uncrating. also booking 1x lapel mic + 1x backup shotgun mic.
DeployBot: runbook template created: /drive/partner-summit/innovation-lab-runbook_v1.pdf
Cara - Marketing: I'll prepare a small two-sided postcard: front demo QR + back promo code. need demo QR URL by Fri.
Ravi (Partnerships): action list: Eli upload tracking & crate details by Wed; Nina publish runbook draft by Thu; Cara deliver postcard art + QR by Fri EOD. fallback plan: local-only demo image preloaded on appliance, and a USB with last-known-good image. tagging team for visibility.
